entries.integration: firmware/esp32-bridge env esp32s2-devkit + @pinout/core esp32-s2 board descriptor
entries.testedHow: host-side only: board JSON/descriptor parity, pin-rule, ADC/PWM membership and channel-bound tests in packages/core; firmware compile pending
entries.notes: Opt-in. PlatformIO 6.5.0 ships no DevKitC-1 definition, so the env builds with the ESP32-S2-Saola-1 definition (same S2 module family, 4 MB flash); the firmware pin table is the DevKitC-1 descriptor. UART0 on GPIO 43/44. Expected compile-clean by inspection; compile and HIL pending. Not certified.

entries.integration: firmware/esp32-bridge env esp32s3-devkit + @pinout/core esp32-s3 board descriptor
entries.testedHow: host-side only: board JSON/descriptor parity, pin-rule, ADC/PWM membership and channel-bound tests in packages/core; firmware compile pending
entries.notes: Opt-in. Same Arduino-ESP32 2.x core line as the classic esp32dev env. UART0 through the USB-to-UART bridge port. GPIO 26-32 (flash) and 33-37 (octal-PSRAM modules) stay reserved. Expected compile-clean by inspection; compile and HIL pending. The onboard addressable RGB LED (GPIO 38 v1.1 / 48 initial) is deliberately not exposed. Not certified.

entries.integration: firmware/esp32-bridge env esp32c6-devkit + @pinout/core esp32-c6 board descriptor
entries.testedHow: host-side only: board JSON/descriptor parity, pin-rule, ADC/PWM membership and channel-bound tests in packages/core; firmware compile pending
entries.notes: Opt-in. Requires the community pioarduino platform (Arduino-ESP32 3.x, pinned by release URL; first build needs network access). LEDC calls go through the src/boards/ledc_compat.h shim, the least-verified code in this workstream. Protocol transport is UART0 on GPIO 16/17 via the board's USB Type-C to UART port. Expected compile-clean by inspection; compile and HIL pending. Not certified.

entries.notes: No hardware verification. Runtime capability detection guards machine.* usage; unsupported capabilities fail with structured codes instead of fabricated values. Requires the MicroPython machine module; CircuitPython is not supported.
